# CLI reference

<!-- Generated by `make cli-docs` from the argus-mint CLI. Do not edit by hand:
     tests/test_cli_docs.py fails when this file differs from the CLI. -->

`argus-mint` (or `python -m argus_mint`) needs the `cli` extra: `pip install "argus-mint[cli]"`.
Logs go to stderr; every command's result is JSON on stdout. Password prompts go to the terminal.

For the review flow these commands drive, see [drafts.md](drafts.md) and [review.md](review.md).

## Commands

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`argus-mint version`](#argus-mint-version) | Print the installed version. |
| [`argus-mint templates`](#argus-mint-templates) | Validate every template under DIRECTORY and list id, version, status and hash. |

## argus-mint version

Print the installed version.

```
argus-mint version [OPTIONS]
```

## argus-mint templates

Validate every template under DIRECTORY and list id, version, status and hash.

```
argus-mint templates [OPTIONS] DIRECTORY
```

| Argument / option | Required | Default | Env | Help |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `DIRECTORY` | yes |  |  | Directory of template YAML files |

## argus-mint preflight

Check TEMPLATE against darkroom before approval: its workflows, then its prompt text.

First, against darkroom's model list: every checkpoint exists and has a workflow for each LoRA count the template allows, and each workflow takes what the template sends (negative prompt, guidance, clip_skip). Then darkroom's text pre-flight on every variable combination. Exits 1 on any problem or refusal.

```
argus-mint preflight [OPTIONS] TEMPLATE
```

| Argument / option | Required | Default | Env | Help |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `TEMPLATE` | yes |  |  | Template YAML file (any status) |
| `--darkroom` |  |  | `ARGUS_MINT_DARKROOM_URL` | argus-darkroom base URL, e.g. http://localhost:8106 |
| `--policy` |  | `default` |  | darkroom enforcing policy (default: the SFW policy) |
| `--limit` |  | `256` |  | Refuse templates with more combinations than this |
| `--text`, `--no-text` |  | `--text` |  | Also run the text pre-flight on every combination |

## argus-mint frames

Validate every frame under DIRECTORY and list id, version, status, size, text slots and hash.

```
argus-mint frames [OPTIONS] DIRECTORY
```

| Argument / option | Required | Default | Env | Help |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `DIRECTORY` | yes |  |  | Directory of frame YAML files |

## argus-mint sample

Render sample cards of TEMPLATE for its reviewer. Local files only: never pins, signs or mints.

Picks COUNT combinations (deterministic for --seed) among those matching --var, renders each through darkroom with the usual safety check and retries, and writes the images to --out. With --frame it also writes framed previews; --bio adds a written bio (any status of template, frame or bio template may be previewed). Prints a JSON summary.

```
argus-mint sample [OPTIONS] TEMPLATE
```

| Argument / option | Required | Default | Env | Help |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `TEMPLATE` | yes |  |  | Template YAML file (any status: drafts are what this is for) |
| `--out` | yes |  |  | Directory for the sample images |
| `--count` |  | `6` |  | How many combinations to render |
| `--var` |  |  |  | Fix a variable to key=value (repeat); the rest vary |
| `--seed` |  | `0` |  | Picks the combinations, and the first render seed |
| `--model` |  |  |  | Checkpoint: the template's default, or one of its `models` |
| `--lora` |  |  |  | A LoRA from the template's lora_options, NAME or NAME@WEIGHT (repeat) |
| `--frame` |  |  |  | Frame YAML to preview (any status) |
| `--name` |  | `Sample` |  | Name drawn in the frame's name slot |
| `--bio` |  |  |  | Bio template YAML: a language model writes the card's bio |
| `--writer` |  |  | `ARGUS_MINT_WRITER_URL` | Bio writer base URL (OpenAI-style POST /chat) |
| `--text` |  |  |  | Display text for a frame slot, slot=text (repeat), e.g. class=Ranger |
| `--darkroom` |  |  | `ARGUS_MINT_DARKROOM_URL` | argus-darkroom base URL, e.g. http://localhost:8106 |
| `--policy` |  | `default` |  | darkroom enforcing policy (default: the SFW policy) |

## argus-mint draft

Step 1 of 3: render a card, write its bio and frame it into a local draft for review.

The art comes from darkroom (--darkroom), a file (--image) or a placeholder. With --bio, a language model at --writer writes the bio, screened by darkroom's text check (so --bio needs --darkroom too). --text fills the frame's other slots (class, stats...) with the consumer's display text. Nothing is pinned or signed: next the moderator and the owner each run `argus-mint review`, then `argus-mint publish`.

```
argus-mint draft [OPTIONS]
```

| Argument / option | Required | Default | Env | Help |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--template` | yes |  |  | Template YAML file (must be approved) |
| `--out` | yes |  |  | Draft directory to create (art.png, card.png, draft.json) |
| `--to` | yes |  |  | Address the card will be minted to (the owner who reviews it) |
| `--name` | yes |  |  | Card name (free text: metadata and image only, never sent to a model) |
| `--var` |  |  |  | Template variable key=value (repeat) |
| `--seed` |  | `0` |  | First render seed |
| `--model` |  |  |  | Checkpoint: the template's default, or one of its `models` |
| `--lora` |  |  |  | A LoRA from the template's lora_options, NAME or NAME@WEIGHT (repeat) |
| `--library` |  |  |  | Pre-rendered library directory (with --entry) |
| `--entry` |  |  |  | Library entry id: its art, variables and seed |
| `--asset-id` |  |  |  | 0x 32-byte asset id |
| `--asset` |  |  |  | Asset key; asset id = keccak256(utf8 key) |
| `--description` |  |  |  | Metadata description (default: the bio, if one is written) |
| `--consumer` |  | `argus-mint` |  | Consumer name recorded in provenance |
| `--external-url` |  |  |  |  |
| `--frame` |  |  |  | Frame YAML to composite on top (must be approved) |
| `--bio` |  |  |  | Bio template YAML: a language model writes the card's bio |
| `--writer` |  |  | `ARGUS_MINT_WRITER_URL` | Bio writer base URL (OpenAI-style POST /chat) |
| `--text` |  |  |  | Display text for a frame slot, slot=text (repeat), e.g. class=Ranger |
| `--image` |  |  |  | Use this image instead of rendering |
| `--darkroom` |  |  | `ARGUS_MINT_DARKROOM_URL` | argus-darkroom base URL, e.g. http://localhost:8106 |
| `--policy` |  | `default` |  | darkroom enforcing policy (default: the SFW policy) |
| `--accept-review`, `--no-accept-review` |  | `--no-accept-review` |  | Accept darkroom 'review' images (default: retry) |
| `--placeholder` |  |  |  | Placeholder art (for dry runs; publish needs --dry-run) |

## argus-mint review

Step 2 of 3: approve or reject a draft's card image (look at it first).

The moderator and the owner each review once. Both must approve before `publish`; a rejection closes the draft. The decision is bound to the image's sha256.

```
argus-mint review [OPTIONS] DRAFT_DIR
```

| Argument / option | Required | Default | Env | Help |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `DRAFT_DIR` | yes |  |  | Draft directory (from `argus-mint draft`) |
| `--as` | yes |  |  | Who is reviewing: moderator \| owner |
| `--by` | yes |  |  | Reviewer's name or id, recorded in the draft |
| `--approve`, `--reject` | yes |  |  | The decision |
| `--note` |  |  |  | Reason, especially for a rejection |

## argus-mint publish

Step 3 of 3: pin an approved draft, build its metadata and sign the mint voucher; print JSON.

Refuses a draft the moderator and the owner haven't both approved, or whose files changed since. A live run pins via --ipfs-api and signs with --account (a Foundry keystore) or $ARGUS_MINT_SIGNER_KEY. A dry run signs with a throwaway key, so its voucher can't mint. Send a live result on-chain with `argus-mint submit`.

```
argus-mint publish [OPTIONS] DRAFT_DIR
```

| Argument / option | Required | Default | Env | Help |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `DRAFT_DIR` | yes |  |  | Approved draft directory |
| `--card` | yes |  |  | Card contract address (EIP-712 verifyingContract) |
| `--network` |  | `base-sepolia` |  | base \| base-sepolia \| anvil (sets the chain id) |
| `--chain-id` |  |  |  | Chain id override (default: from --network) |
| `--price` |  | `0` |  | Mint price in wei |
| `--ttl` |  | `3600` |  | Voucher lifetime in seconds |
| `--deadline` |  |  |  | Voucher deadline (unix seconds); overrides --ttl |
| `--ipfs-api` |  |  | `ARGUS_MINT_IPFS_API` | Kubo RPC URL for pinning, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:5001 |
| `--account` |  |  | `ARGUS_MINT_ACCOUNT` | Foundry keystore account (name in ~/.foundry/keystores, or a path); password from $ARGUS_MINT_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD_FILE or a prompt. Default: $ARGUS_MINT_SIGNER_KEY |
| `--dry-run` |  |  |  | Pin locally (no IPFS) and sign with a throwaway key, never the real one |

## argus-mint submit

Send a signed mint voucher to its Card contract; print the new token id.

Any account may submit a voucher (normally the player's wallet); it pays the gas and the voucher's price. The card goes to the voucher's `to` address, not the sender. The voucher names its contract, and the checks run against it, so it must be the --card you trust.

```
argus-mint submit [OPTIONS] MINT_JSON
```

| Argument / option | Required | Default | Env | Help |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `MINT_JSON` | yes |  |  | JSON printed by `argus-mint publish` ('-' for stdin) |
| `--card` | yes |  | `ARGUS_MINT_CARD` | The Card contract you mean to mint on; the voucher must name it |
| `--network` |  | `base-sepolia` |  | base \| base-sepolia \| anvil |
| `--rpc-url` |  |  | `ARGUS_MINT_RPC_URL` | JSON-RPC URL (default: the network's public endpoints) |
| `--account` |  |  | `ARGUS_MINT_ACCOUNT` | Foundry keystore account (name in ~/.foundry/keystores, or a path); password from $ARGUS_MINT_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD_FILE or a prompt. Default: $ARGUS_MINT_SIGNER_KEY |

## argus-mint freeze

Fix a card's metadata at an IPFS URI for good (METADATA_ROLE; once per token).

After this, tokenURI returns URI, wallets and explorers can show the card, and the metadata can no longer be refreshed.

```
argus-mint freeze [OPTIONS]
```

| Argument / option | Required | Default | Env | Help |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--card` | yes |  |  | Card contract address |
| `--token-id` | yes |  |  | Token to freeze |
| `--uri` | yes |  |  | Final metadata: ipfs://<cid> or a bare CID |
| `--network` |  | `base-sepolia` |  | base \| base-sepolia \| anvil |
| `--rpc-url` |  |  | `ARGUS_MINT_RPC_URL` | JSON-RPC URL (default: the network's public endpoints) |
| `--account` |  |  | `ARGUS_MINT_ACCOUNT` | Foundry keystore account (name in ~/.foundry/keystores, or a path); password from $ARGUS_MINT_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD_FILE or a prompt. Default: $ARGUS_MINT_SIGNER_KEY |

## argus-mint anchor

Build a Merkle tree over LEAVES and anchor its root in the Ledger (COMMITTER_ROLE).

Leaves are the consumer's 32-byte record hashes; blank lines and # comments are skipped. Keep the --tree dump: proofs for individual records come from it.

```
argus-mint anchor [OPTIONS] LEAVES
```

| Argument / option | Required | Default | Env | Help |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `LEAVES` | yes |  |  | File of 32-byte 0x leaf values, one per line ('-' for stdin) |
| `--ledger` | yes |  |  | Ledger contract address |
| `--epoch` | yes |  |  | Epoch to anchor (once per epoch) |
| `--tree` |  |  |  | Write the tree (standard-v1 dump, for proofs) here |
| `--network` |  | `base-sepolia` |  | base \| base-sepolia \| anvil |
| `--rpc-url` |  |  | `ARGUS_MINT_RPC_URL` | JSON-RPC URL (default: the network's public endpoints) |
| `--account` |  |  | `ARGUS_MINT_ACCOUNT` | Foundry keystore account (name in ~/.foundry/keystores, or a path); password from $ARGUS_MINT_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD_FILE or a prompt. Default: $ARGUS_MINT_SIGNER_KEY |

## argus-mint serve

Serve drafts, reviews and publishing over HTTP for argus-studio and argus-assay.

Configured by ARGUS_MINT_* variables (README: Configuration): DRAFTS_DIR, SAMPLES_DIR, LIBRARY_DIR, TEMPLATES_DIR, FRAMES_DIR, BIOS_DIR, DARKROOM_URL, POLICY, WRITER_URL, WRITER_KEY, IPFS_API, ACCOUNT (+ KEYSTORE_PASSWORD_FILE, KEYSTORE_DIR) or SIGNER_KEY, NETWORK, CARD, CONSUMER, VOUCHER_TTL, MODERATOR_TOKEN, POSTER_TOKEN, SIWE_DOMAIN, SIWE_URI, CORS_ORIGINS, READ_ONLY, AUTO_MODERATE, BLOCKLIST, PROJECTS_DIR, SPOILERS, CONSENT_DIR, BACKGROUNDS_DIR.

```
argus-mint serve [OPTIONS]
```

| Argument / option | Required | Default | Env | Help |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--host` |  | `127.0.0.1` |  | Bind address (default: localhost only) |
| `--port` |  | `8108` |  | Port |
| `--cors` |  |  |  | Comma-separated browser origins allowed to call it (overrides the env) |

## argus-mint schema

Write (or --check) the HTTP wire schema that argus-studio and argus-assay pin.

```
argus-mint schema [OPTIONS]
```

| Argument / option | Required | Default | Env | Help |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--check` |  |  |  | Fail if the committed schema is out of date |
| `--path` |  | `schema/mint-wire.schema.json` |  | Schema file |

## argus-mint export

Write each approved teaser of PROJECT as T<n>.png (the reviewed bytes) and T<n>.json (its record).

The record: the draft, each linked file by id, version and hash, the background, the frame and texts, the render (seeds, checkpoint, LoRAs, the inpainting input), the reviews, the posts and the anchors holding the image (with its Merkle proof). For a number with several approved drafts, the newest posted one is written, else the newest.

```
argus-mint export [OPTIONS] PROJECT
```

| Argument / option | Required | Default | Env | Help |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `PROJECT` | yes |  |  | Project id |
| `--out` | yes |  |  | Directory for T<n>.png and T<n>.json |
| `--drafts` |  | `drafts` | `ARGUS_MINT_DRAFTS_DIR` | The server's drafts directory |
| `--anchors` |  | `anchors` | `ARGUS_MINT_ANCHORS_DIR` | Where each project's anchors and trees are kept |
| `--backgrounds` |  |  | `ARGUS_MINT_BACKGROUNDS_DIR` | Backgrounds directory (adds their seeds) |

## argus-mint teasers

Teaser projects: anchoring posted teasers.

Subcommands: `anchor`.

## argus-mint teasers anchor

Anchor the image sha256s of PROJECT's posted teasers that no earlier anchor holds (COMMITTER_ROLE).

Each leaf's value is the 32-byte sha256 of a posted teaser's PNG (the reviewed image, byte for byte), hashed as any `anchor` leaf is. The tree is written before the transaction is sent; the anchor (epoch, root, leaves, tx, tree path) is then recorded in <anchors>/<project>/anchors.json.

```
argus-mint teasers anchor [OPTIONS] PROJECT
```

| Argument / option | Required | Default | Env | Help |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `PROJECT` | yes |  |  | Project id |
| `--ledger` | yes |  |  | Ledger contract address |
| `--epoch` | yes |  |  | Epoch to anchor (once per epoch) |
| `--tree` |  |  |  | Write the tree here (default: <anchors>/<project>/epoch-<N>-tree.json) |
| `--drafts` |  | `drafts` | `ARGUS_MINT_DRAFTS_DIR` | The server's drafts directory |
| `--anchors` |  | `anchors` | `ARGUS_MINT_ANCHORS_DIR` | Where each project's anchors and trees are kept |
| `--network` |  | `base-sepolia` |  | base \| base-sepolia \| anvil |
| `--rpc-url` |  |  | `ARGUS_MINT_RPC_URL` | JSON-RPC URL (default: the network's public endpoints) |
| `--account` |  |  | `ARGUS_MINT_ACCOUNT` | Foundry keystore account (name in ~/.foundry/keystores, or a path); password from $ARGUS_MINT_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD_FILE or a prompt. Default: $ARGUS_MINT_SIGNER_KEY |

## argus-mint library

Pre-rendered portraits, for a demo without a GPU.

Subcommands: `build`, `list`.

## argus-mint library build

Render COUNT combinations of TEMPLATE on each checkpoint, same variables and seeds on each.

Model by model, so each checkpoint loads once; interrupted builds resume. Every image goes through darkroom's safety check, with the usual retries.

```
argus-mint library build [OPTIONS] TEMPLATE
```

| Argument / option | Required | Default | Env | Help |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `TEMPLATE` | yes |  |  | Template YAML (any status) |
| `--out` |  | `library` |  | Library directory (resumes if it exists) |
| `--count` |  | `48` |  | Variable combinations per checkpoint |
| `--seed` |  | `0` |  | Picks the combinations; group n renders with seed*1000+n |
| `--model` |  |  |  | Checkpoint (repeat); default: all the template allows |
| `--darkroom` |  |  | `ARGUS_MINT_DARKROOM_URL` | argus-darkroom base URL, e.g. http://localhost:8106 |
| `--policy` |  | `default` |  | darkroom enforcing policy (default: the SFW policy) |

## argus-mint library list

Summarise a library: template, checkpoints, entries.

```
argus-mint library list [OPTIONS] [DIRECTORY]
```

| Argument / option | Required | Default | Env | Help |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `DIRECTORY` |  | `library` |  | Library directory |
